# A 150.00 CAD deposit into `Assets:Bank` against two other splits: 100.00 on
# `Assets:Suspense` and 50.00 on `Assets:Clearing`. INV-150 for 150.00 has two
# payment blocks. The first states the suspense split with `txn_split_guid:` and
# `account: "Assets:Bank"`, so that split becomes the receivable's. The second
# states the clearing split, and says the money is in `Assets:Suspense`.
#
# When the file is read the deposit still has its suspense split, so the second
# block's account is one the transaction used. When the second block is applied
# the first has moved that split onto the receivable, and nothing is left on
# `Assets:Suspense` to read the clearing split's worth from.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal, and nothing imported.
#
# Load after `payment_roundtrip_accounts.txt`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_payment_block_stating_an_account_an_earlier_block_emptied_is_refused.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets:Suspense
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Clearing
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

2026-01-15 * "Deposit"
	guid: "a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9"
	Assets:Bank 150.00 CAD
		guid: "b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8b8"
	Assets:Suspense -100.00 CAD
		guid: "c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7"
	Assets:Clearing -50.00 CAD
		guid: "d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6"

invoice "INV-150"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 150
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-150"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9"
		txn_split_guid: "c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7c7"
		memo: "Deposit"
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 50
		account: "Assets:Suspense"
		txn_guid: "a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9a9"
		txn_split_guid: "d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6d6"
		memo: "The rest"
